subject: literacy
concept: Understanding how word choice affects the tone and mood of a passage
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two versions of the same sentence with different word choices and identifies the mood shift
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a passage's mood to a pictured emotion based on its word choices
exercise.abstract: Student identifies specific word choices that create a passage's tone or mood

misconception_flags: identifies the correct mood but cannot point to the specific words that create it

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
